So before I compute a single mean, I run the same short ritual. It takes five minutes and has saved me from shipping wrong conclusions more times than I can count.

Your first thought might be:
"Why did half of my React app render again? Isn't this bad for performance?"
Not necessarily.

Template::Stencil takes the other route. A template is parsed once into packed bytecode in a single memory arena, and rendered by a threaded C interpr
